observations.notes: FY26 (ended Mar-26) ecosystem revenue >$7.3bn, ecosystem Adj EBITDA $1.1bn.

financials_multi_year.source: Prosus N.V. H1 FY2027 Interim Financial Results (ended 30-Sep-26), read 26-Nov-26

observations.notes: H1 FY27 rev $5.7bn (+10% reported / +16% LFL), Adj EBITDA ~$492-500m; FY27 rev guided $12.0-12.3bn. Raised $1.65bn in 7Y (5.528% 2033) & 10Y (5.873% 2036) notes to pre-fund 2027 maturities.

verdict.summary: Prosus grew H1 FY27 ecosystem revenue 16% LFL to $5.7bn (~$496m Adj EBITDA; FY27 revenue guided $12.0-12.3bn) after $7.3bn rev / $1.1bn EBITDA in FY26. Proactive $1.65bn 2033/2036 issuance pre-funded 2027 maturities, leaving vast Tencent/e-commerce NAV asset coverage above HoldCo debt.

positives: Massive liquid Tencent stake + profitable consolidated e-commerce ($1.1bn FY26 Adj EBITDA) yielding conservative HoldCo LTV.
Strategic Technology market positioning in South Africa supporting resilient operating cash generation.
negatives: Tencent dividend/regulatory sensitivity in China and ongoing open-ended share buybacks.
M&A deployment risk across European/LatAm food delivery and classifieds.
Exposure to South Africa macro/FX volatility and sovereign spread widening cycles.

background.business_overview: Global consumer internet group (Naspers subsidiary) holding Tencent stake plus consolidated e-commerce/fintech/food delivery.
background.asset_perimeter: Tencent equity stake + iFood, PayU, OLX, eMAG.
background.ownership_governance: Euronext Amsterdam listed (PRX); controlled by Naspers (South Africa).

recent_drivers: Nov-26 H1 FY27: Ecosystem rev $5.7bn (+16% LFL), Adj EBITDA ~$496m; FY27 rev guided $12.0-12.3bn.

management_questions.question: Detail gross cash balance and net cash/debt at HoldCo post-$1.65bn bond issuance and ongoing Tencent trim.
Confirm 2027 maintenance vs growth capex flexibility and free cash flow breakeven assumptions.
Detail refinancing roadmap and liquidity coverage for upcoming 2027-2028 debt maturities.
